column1: Clause  2  :  This  clause  amends  section  7  of  the  Mediation  Boards Act,  No.  72  of  1988
(hereinafter  referred  to  as  the  "principal  enactment")  and  the  legal  effect  of  that  section
as  amended  is  to  enable  the  court  of  First  Instance  to  entertain  any  application  without  the
certificate  of  non  settlement,  from  any  party  to  a  dispute  in  respect  of  any  offence
referred  to  in  second  Schedule  of  the  principal  enactment,  if  such  party  admits  such  non
settlement  before  court  or  indicate  unwillingness  to  resolve  the  matter  through  mediation.
